svg.title: RotarySMP Schaublin 125-CNC owner retrofit individual-conductor retrofit diagram
svg.desc: Exact controller, interface, driver, supply and machine terminal labels are joined by separate conductors. Dotted routes are proposed unverified guesses. OPEN breaks identify the missing connection. Numbering is logical, not a mating-face view.

text.tspan: RotarySMP Schaublin 125-CNC owner retrofit · individual conductor plan

svg.text: Dotted = GUESS / proposed conversion, verify before energizing · Green = retained source path · Broken = OPEN
Each circle is one named physical pin, terminal or identified lead. Connector orientation and fitted revision must match.
Crossing lines are not junctions. Connections exist only at the named terminal circles and explicitly shared nets.

text.tspan: Retained owner-reported spindle circuit: Mesa 7i83 analogout0 → unknown VFD

svg.text: OPEN
OPEN
OPEN
Owner reports 7i83 analogout0 commands VFD speed. A later post identifies physical VFD Pin 28 as drive enable while
discussing analog 0-10V speed command and stop behavior. Pin 28 is an owner-reported terminal label/function only; identify
the VFD model and verify all actual connections. M3/M4 failure was reported even while panel buttons functioned.

text.tspan: Owner-reported spindle encoder feedback; Smoothie compatibility blocked

svg.text: OPEN
OPEN
Thread documents Mesa encoder speed feedback, not encoder model, A/B/Z electrical standard or connector schedule. No
arbitrary direct encoder connection to Core/Prime is proposed.

text.tspan: JMC servo control compatibility decision (not a pin-level connection)
verify exact drive supports pulse position

svg.text: OPEN
OPEN
Owner post #259199 explicitly says the JMC drives are running in analog mode. Either verify the exact installed drives can be
configured for compatible pulse-position commands, or retain a supported closed-loop motion controller/drive architecture. No
Core-to-analog position loop is proposed.

text.tspan: Pneumatic backgear: valve identity and stopped-spindle interlock required

svg.text: OPEN
OPEN
OPEN
Owner says gear changes only with spindle stopped, and no gear-position sensor is fitted/reported. Planned 7i84/brake outputs
were not confirmed installed. Identify manifold station and coil; add independent spindle-stopped permissive before any
actuation.

text.tspan: Preserve existing physical spindle/safety controls until traced and verified

svg.text: OPEN
OPEN
Thread reports damaged spare Mesa 7i84 and planned quick-stop/brake at cited time; current installation unknown. Do not label
planned parts as installed. Keep safety and contactor logic independent of Smoothie.
Read the exact per-wire schedule, full contact inventory, parts, configuration and source checks in the accompanying profile.
